title: Crab Derby, 2005 · before
logline: The day before the twenty-first: a neighbor's toddler at the shack with a crayon, and the flyer on the counter half done. Gully holds the kid; the kid holds the crayon; the crayon reaches. Wood sees the collaboration coming and lets it.

panels.composition: The shack. WOOD at the counter with the flyer half drawn. GULLY with a neighbor's toddler on his hip. BARNABY.
